BG3FLOW.DepsMissing: BG3 Flow is disabled. Missing or outdated:

enableAutomation.Name: Full automation
enableAutomation.Hint: Friend-or-foe prompt for areas that allow choosing targets. Use the preset button in this section to set up Midi QOL.

enableTurns.Name: BG3 turn flow
enableTurns.Hint: Consecutive allies share one turn; movement locked off-turn and budgeted on-turn.

sharedTurnEnd.Name: Shared turn ends when every player is done
sharedTurnEnd.Hint: A player's End turn (the tracker, or the flag button in the token HUD) ends only their own part; the group's turn moves on when every connected player of the group has ended, or when the GM presses next.

enableEncounters.Name: Encounters and stealth
enableEncounters.Hint: Preset enemy groups that start combat when they spot or hurt a player.

lockGmMovement.Name: Lock GM movement too
lockGmMovement.Hint: If on, the GM is also blocked from moving tokens outside their turn.

defaultEncounterRadius.Name: Default encounter radius (ft)
defaultEncounterRadius.Hint: Detection distance proposed when marking an encounter.

obscuredDarkness.Name: Obscured darkness threshold
obscuredDarkness.Hint: Scene darkness (0 to 1) at or above which an unlit position is heavily obscured. Dim light there is lightly obscured, bright light is clear.

dashNames.Name: Dash item names
dashNames.Hint: Comma-separated item names that double the movement budget for the turn when used.

enableAutopilot.Name: Monster autopilot
enableAutopilot.Hint: Combatants with no player owner play their own turns: move, attack, pass. Switch per combatant with the robot button in the combat tracker.

pauseBeforeAttack.Name: Pause before each monster action
pauseBeforeAttack.Hint: Ask the GM (Execute, Skip, Take over) before every automatic use.

autoNextTurn.Name: Pass the turn automatically
autoNextTurn.Hint: When every active monster was automatic, the autopilot passes the turn.

intelligenceThreshold.Name: Intelligence threshold
intelligenceThreshold.Hint: Intelligence at or above which a monster finishes the most wounded target instead of the nearest.

fleeEnabled.Name: Monsters flee
fleeEnabled.Hint: A monster below the flee threshold runs for an escape region (Dash) or away from everyone: unintelligent ones always, intelligent ones only when outnumbered. A creature alone from the start never flees.

fleeThreshold.Name: Flee threshold (% of max hp)
fleeThreshold.Hint: Below this share of its maximum hit points a monster flees.

escapeRegionName.Name: Escape region name
escapeRegionName.Hint: Regions whose name contains this word are escape routes: a fleeing monster that enters one leaves the fight (defeated and hidden).

lairActions.Name: Lair actions
lairActions.Hint: At the top of every round, a monster in its lair takes the lair action that hurts the party most; the GM is told which lair actions were left for their hands.

enlargeStrength.Name: Enlarge: Strength twice
enlargeStrength.Hint: An enlarged character adds its Strength modifier a second time instead of the 1d4 on Strength attacks (other attacks keep the 1d4). Applied to the Enlarge effect when it is created.

preparedSpells.Name: New spells arrive prepared
preparedSpells.Hint: A spell of the prepared kind added to a character is marked prepared on creation (imported automations tend to leave it unprepared). Other preparation modes and NPCs are untouched.

grappleAction.Name: Grapple action on every character
grappleAction.Hint: Chris's Premades' Grapple item (the contest, the Grappled condition, the escape) is added to every player character that lacks it. A grappler walks at half speed and drags what it holds along.

lightSpells.Name: Light spells light the token
lightSpells.Hint: Light, Continual Flame and Daylight light the picked token; Produce Flame the caster; Faerie Fire whoever failed. The light ends when Light or Produce Flame is cast again, when the flame is thrown, when concentration drops, or with the token HUD button. No Active Token Effects module needed.

askSpellLevel.Name: Ask the spell level
askSpellLevel.Hint: A leveled spell cast with a higher slot still available opens the slot dialog, even with Midi consuming resources by itself. Cantrips and reactions never ask.

targetPicker.Name: Target picker
targetPicker.Hint: Every single-target spell or attack shows its range and takes its targets from your clicks, like BG3; targets left from the last use are dropped. Esc or a right click cancels the use.

actionEconomy.Name: Action economy
actionEconomy.Hint: One action and one bonus action per turn (Extra Attack, off-hand attacks and Action Surge understood), shown above the token as a green dot and an orange triangle. Players: players are stopped, the GM is warned. Display: icons only. Monsters on the autopilot are never checked.

Preset.Hint: Configure Midi QOL for fully automatic attacks, damage and saves with public dice.
Preset.Title: BG3 automation preset
Preset.Confirm:
This overwrites Midi QOL's workflow settings so attacks, damage and saves resolve with no prompts, all dice public, templates auto-target everyone inside, and reaction prompts (Shield, Uncanny Dodge, opportunity attacks) are on with a 30 second timeout. It also turns off dnd5e's own initiative grouping.

You can tweak any setting afterwards. Apply?

Economy.NoAction: {name} has no action left this turn.
Economy.NoBonus: {name} has no bonus action left this turn.

Picker.Pick: {name}: click a target within {range} ({count} needed). Esc or right click cancels.
Picker.More: {name} at a higher level: click {count} more within {range}. Esc keeps the targets you have.

Targets.Title: Who does it affect?
Targets.Hint: This spell lets you spare your allies. Who should the area hurt?

Turns.NoMovement: Not enough movement: {spent} of {limit} ft already used.
Turns.Waiting: Your turn is over. Waiting for: {names}.
Turns.Dominated: {name} is dominated: the DM plays it.
Turns.Confused: {name} is confused (d10 {roll}): this turn is not yours to play.

Grapple.Missing: bg3-flow: Chris's Premades' Grapple item was not found in its compendium (CPR Miscellaneous 2014): the Grapple action was not added.

Features.EngulfedHint: Engulfed by {by}: restrained, cannot breathe, takes the acid at the start of each of {by}'s turns. Escape: an action and a DC {dc} Strength check; on a success it moves 5 ft out. Remove this effect when it is free.
Features.EngulfedLine: {names} engulfed by {by}: restrained, cannot breathe, acid at the start of each of its turns. Escape: an action and a DC {dc} Strength check.

Light.Flame: Produce Flame: the flame is in your hand. Target a creature to throw it.

Autopilot.UnknownCommand: {name}: command "{word}" not understood (approach, drop, flee, grovel, halt): playing as usual.
Autopilot.Controlled: {name} is charmed or dominated: the DM plays it this turn.

Confusion.Stumble: {name} is confused (d10 {roll}): stumbles {dir} with all its movement and takes no action.
Confusion.Nothing: {name} is confused (d10 {roll}): does nothing this turn.
Confusion.Attack: {name} is confused (d10 {roll}): must make a melee attack on {target}.
Confusion.NoOne: {name} is confused (d10 {roll}): no one within reach, it does nothing.
Confusion.Normal: {name} is confused (d10 {roll}): acts normally this turn.
